mechanism: Sacubitril (neprilysin inhibitor) potentiates vasodilation and hypotensive effects; timolol ophthalmic absorption can cause systemic beta-blockade that may oppose sacubitril's cardiac benefits and increase hypotension risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely when initiating or adjusting either agent; ensure adequate spacing between ophthalmic timolol instillation and systemic sacubitril dosing; assess for excessive hypotension or bradycardia symptoms.
